comment: Wabistay state machine (H0). state → input → action → next state, plus all outbound message copy. Handlers in api/wabistay/webhook.js read this table — no nested if-state logic. Inputs are matched against the trimmed, lowercased message; "*" is the fallback row. "next" is the Session State the action writes (handlers control write ordering; a handler may stay in-state, e.g. invalid details or the F14 cooldown guard).

messages.consentNotice:
Welcome to {propertyName} 👋

Quick note before we start: we collect your name, number and stay dates to manage your booking. We keep it safe and don't share it with anyone. Carrying on with this chat means you're OK with that.

Reply STOP anytime to opt out of messages.
messages.greeting:
Hi! 👋 Welcome to {propertyName}{propertyCityLine}.

We currently have *{roomCountText}* available.

*Our rates:*
{rateText}

To make an *overnight booking*, please send:
1. Your full name
2. Check-in date (e.g. 25 June)
3. Check-out date (e.g. 27 June)

Send all three, each on a new line.

_For short stay bookings, reply HOURLY and we'll assist you._
messages.detailsReprompt:
Sorry, I didn't quite get that. Please reply with your:
1. Full name
2. Check-in date (e.g. 25 June)
3. Check-out date (e.g. 27 June)

Send each on a new line.
messages.noAvailability:
Sorry {guestName}, we're fully booked from *{checkIn}* to *{checkOut}*. 😔

We'd still love to host you — would you like to try different dates? Please reply with your:
1. Full name
2. Check-in date (e.g. 25 June)
3. Check-out date (e.g. 27 June)

Send each on a new line.
messages.bookingCreateFailed:
Sorry {guestName}, something went wrong on our end and we couldn't save your booking. Nothing was charged. Please resend your details:
1. Full name
2. Check-in date (e.g. 25 June)
3. Check-out date (e.g. 27 June)

Send each on a new line.
messages.hourlyAskDetails:
Great — let's set up your *short stay* at {propertyName}. 🕐

Please send:
1. Your full name
2. What time you'll arrive (e.g. 2pm or 14:00)

Send both, each on a new line.
messages.hourlyDetailsReprompt:
Sorry, I didn't quite get that. Please reply with your:
1. Full name
2. Arrival time (e.g. 2pm or 14:00)

Send each on a new line.
messages.hourlyTimeAmbiguous:
Just to be sure — did you mean *{value}am* or *{value}pm*?

Please reply with the full time, e.g. "{value}pm".
messages.hourlyDurationMenu:
Great {guestName}! 🕐 Arriving *{arrivalText}*.

How long do you need? Reply with a number:
1 - 1 hour (R{rate1})
2 - 2 hours (R{rate2})
3 - 3 hours (R{rate3})

_Staying longer than 3 hours? Reply 4 and we'll set up an overnight booking instead._
messages.hourlyNoAvailability:
Sorry {guestName}, we're fully booked from *{checkInText}* to *{checkOutText}*. 😔

Would you like to try a different time? Please reply with your:
1. Full name
2. Arrival time (e.g. 2pm or 14:00)

Send each on a new line.
messages.hourlyBookingCreateFailed:
Sorry {guestName}, something went wrong on our end and we couldn't save your short stay. Nothing was charged. Please resend your details:
1. Full name
2. Arrival time (e.g. 2pm or 14:00)

Send each on a new line.
messages.hourlyTooLong:
No problem — for stays longer than 3 hours we'll book you overnight instead. 🛏️

Please send:
1. Your full name
2. Check-in date (e.g. 25 June)
3. Check-out date (e.g. 27 June)

Send all three, each on a new line.
messages.hourlyUnavailable:
Sorry, short stays aren't available at {propertyName} at the moment. 😔

We'd be happy to book you overnight instead. Please send:
1. Your full name
2. Check-in date (e.g. 25 June)
3. Check-out date (e.g. 27 June)

Send all three, each on a new line.
messages.gateTooEarly:
Hi {guestName}! Your booking is for *{bookingDate}*, not today. 📅

We'll see you then! If you need to change your booking, just let us know.
messages.occupancyMenu:
Thanks {guestName}! 🛏️ One more thing so we can quote the right rate.

How many of you are staying? Reply with a number:
1 - Just me
2 - Two of us
messages.occupancyContactOwner:
Thanks {guestName}! 🙏 We've got your dates.

We couldn't confirm a rate for that just yet — the owner will be in touch shortly to finalise the price. Your room is being held in the meantime.

What time do you expect to arrive? (e.g. "around 2pm" or "after 5")
messages.etaConfirmed:
Perfect! We'll have your room ready for you. 🛏️

See you at *{eta}*.

When you arrive, reply with a number:
1 - I'm at the gate
2 - Cancel my booking

We look forward to hosting you at {propertyName}! 🌟
messages.gateNoRoomInfo: No rooms available — please assign manually.

Someone is on their way to open the gate for you. Enjoy your stay!

When you're ready to leave, reply with a number:
1 - Check out
messages.welcomeUnassigned:
Welcome to {propertyName}! 🌟 We've notified someone to assist you at the gate.

Enjoy your stay! When you're ready to leave, reply with a number:
1 - Check out
messages.cancelled: Your booking has been cancelled. No problem at all — we hope to see you another time. 👋
messages.confirmedMenu:

Reply with a number:
1 - I'm at the gate
2 - Cancel my booking
messages.gateCooldownMenu: Just checked you in — give it a minute before checking out. Reply 1 again in a bit if you still need to leave.
messages.checkedInMenu:
Hi {guestName}! You're checked in. 🛏️

Reply with a number:
1 - Check out
messages.cleanerDispatch:

Reply *DONE* when complete.

Hi {guestName}, checkout time at {propertyName} has arrived. ⏰

Need more time? Reply *EXTEND* to stay longer.
Ready to go? Reply *1* to check out.

If we don't hear from you within 15 minutes, we'll check you out automatically.

Enjoy — reply *1* to check out whenever you're ready.

messages.cleanerThanks: Thank you! {roomName} is marked as clean and available. ✅
messages.ownerRoomCleaned: ✅ {roomName} has been cleaned and is now available for new bookings.
messages.cleanerNothingToClean: Thanks! No rooms currently marked for cleaning — nothing to update.
messages.cleanerWhichRoom: Which room? Reply with the room number or name. Currently cleaning: {roomList}
messages.unknownFallback: Hi! Reply with your name and dates to make a booking, or *CHECKING OUT* if you are leaving today.
messages.numberNotConfigured: Sorry, this number isn't configured yet. Please contact support.
messages.optedOut:

Reply *START* at any time to opt back in.

messages.walkinUsage:
Walk-in format:

*WALKIN ROOM 2 2HRS John Smith*

Room, then 1, 2 or 3 hours, then the guest's name. Add their number at the end if you have it.
messages.walkinNeedName:
Almost — that walk-in needs the guest's name.

Send it again like this:
*WALKIN ROOM 2 2HRS John Smith*

Add their number at the end if you have it.
messages.walkinBadDuration:
Walk-ins are 1, 2 or 3 hours only — {hours} isn't available.

Example: *WALKIN ROOM 2 2HRS John Smith*
messages.walkinNoSuchRoom:
No room matching "{roomToken}" at this property.

Use the room number or its name, like *WALKIN ROOM 2 2HRS John Smith*
messages.walkinRoomTaken:
{roomName} isn't free for that time — it's already booked.

Try another room.
messages.walkinRatesUnavailable: Short-stay rates aren't set up for {propertyName} yet, so a walk-in can't be priced. Please set the hourly rates first.
messages.walkinWrongProperty: That walk-in is for a different property to the one this number handles. Please send it from that property's number.
messages.walkinNotConfigured: Your staff profile isn't linked to a property yet, so a walk-in can't be created. Please contact the owner.
messages.walkinFailed: Something went wrong saving that walk-in — nothing was booked. Please try again.
messages.paidUsage:
Payment format:

*PAID ROOM 2 500*

Room, then the amount received. Add CASH, EFT or CARD at the end if it wasn't cash.
messages.paidNoSuchRoom:
No room matching "{roomToken}" at this property.

Use the room number, like *PAID ROOM 2 500*
messages.paidNoBooking: No booking found for {roomName} to record a payment against.
messages.paidNotConfigured: Your staff profile isn't linked to a property yet, so a payment can't be recorded. Please contact the owner.
messages.paidWrongProperty: That room is at a different property to the one this number handles. Please send it from that property's number.
messages.paidAlreadyRecorded: Already recorded — {roomName} ({bookingRef}) was settled at R{amountPaid}. Nothing changed.
messages.paidWriteFailed: Something went wrong saving that payment for {roomName} — nothing was recorded. Please try *PAID ROOM* again.
